sources.title: Parameterized Study of the Test Cover Problem
sources.enterprise_use: Provides direct prior art for selecting a minimum family of tests whose outcomes distinguish every pair of items. The P018/P023 bridge is treated as a structured arithmetic specialization of this generic identification problem.
sources.not_claimed: Minimum test cover, pairwise distinguishing test families, and their generic optimization problem are established prior work.

sources.title: (Non-)existence of Polynomial Kernels for the Test Cover Problem
sources.enterprise_use: Documents the generic Test Cover formulation and its nontrivial computational complexity, calibrating the significance of obtaining an exact closed minimum basis in the quotient-root specialization.
sources.not_claimed: Generic Test Cover complexity, kernelization questions, or minimum distinguishing-test optimization are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: The distribution of k-free numbers
sources.enterprise_use: Provides modern primary-source calibration for classical k-free integer counting, including the standard main term x/zeta(k). The bridge uses power-free integers as established arithmetic objects.
sources.not_claimed: Power-free integers, their decomposition, or their classical density/counting theory are prior mathematics.
